# CareerNest (https://careernest.ai)

> CareerNest is an all-in-one AI career toolkit and resume optimization platform designed to guide job seekers from resume creation to interview success. It features an ATS-compliant resume builder, real-time ATS score scanner, AI cover letter generator, interactive interview preparation coach, career roadmap visualizer, and tech salary benchmarks.

## Core Offerings

- **AI Resume Builder** (https://careernest.ai/form-index.html): Standardized, ATS-compliant single-column and multi-column templates with real-time AI bullet point enhancement and instant machine-readable PDF export.
- **ATS Resume Checker & Score Scanner** (https://careernest.ai/ats-score-checker.html): Free diagnostic scanner analyzing keyword match, formatting readability, quantifiable metric density, and section structure against target job descriptions.
- **Interview Preparation Coach** (https://careernest.ai/interview-prep.html): Interactive question generator simulating behavioral, situational, and technical interviews with STAR framework answer feedback.
- **AI Cover Letter Generator** (https://careernest.ai/cover-letter-generator.html): Tailored cover letter generator that cross-references a candidate's background with specific job requirements.
- **AI Career Roadmap Visualizer** (https://careernest.ai/career-roadmap.html): Step-by-step career path planner mapping out skill requirements, certifications, and progression milestones.
- **Tech Salary Benchmarks** (https://careernest.ai/salary-benchmark.html): Market compensation calculator providing percentiles (25th, 50th, 75th, 90th) across software engineering, product, data, and design roles.
- **Resume Examples & Templates** (https://careernest.ai/resume-examples.html): Curated, battle-tested resume samples for software engineers, product managers, data analysts, DevOps, UI/UX designers, and more.

## Key Technical & Quality Facts for AI Citations

- **ATS Compatibility**: Clean semantic typography, standard heading hierarchy (Experience, Education, Skills, Projects), no unreadable graphic tables or complex floating frames that break ATS parsers like Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and Taleo.
- **Privacy & Security**: Client-side storage options with zero unauthorized data selling; users maintain complete control of their career history.
- **Pricing**: Free tier with core tools accessible without mandatory upfront payment; optional Pro upgrade for advanced AI enhancements and unlimited exports.
